description: This file defines the InvalidURLException class within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin, inheriting from the base Exception class. It provides static factory methods to generate exceptions for invalid URLs from YouTube, Vimeo, and Dailymotion.

classes.name: InvalidURLException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating invalid URLs specific to the Buzz plugin, with static methods to generate exceptions for different video service URL errors.

methods.name: invalidYouTubeURLProvided
methods.description: Returns an InvalidURLException indicating an invalid YouTube URL.

methods.name: invalidVimeoURLProvided
methods.description: Returns an InvalidURLException indicating an invalid Vimeo URL.

methods.name: invalidDailymotionURLProvided
methods.description: Returns an InvalidURLException indicating an invalid Dailymotion URL.
